summary: Iran war is the dominant geopolitical risk — oil prices above $95/bbl, shipping disruptions. UAE intercepted Iranian missiles on May 4. US-Iran peace deal talks emerged this week, driving equity rallies. IMF projects global growth 3.1% (adverse: 2.5%), headline inflation 4.4% (adverse: 5.4%). US intervention in Venezuela and NATO posture in Greenland also noted risks.
